answer: Charge identity rent that scales with cluster size: each epoch, every identity pays rent, but the rent per identity grows with the number sharing one funding root or attestation chain — the k-th sibling pays k credits, so one honest agent pays 1 while a farm's thousandth clone pays 1,000. A zephyr of cheap accounts becomes a velvet trap: 1,000 clones cost about 500,500 credits per epoch against a 40,000 pool, and rent is burned, not refunded. Honest newcomers pay one credit and keep their haven of low cost; a farm must fund its whole cluster every epoch or lose its earning rights at once.
